name: Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab (pMMR advanced endometrial)
cyclesNote: lenvatinib is continuous daily; pembrolizumab every 3 weeks (or 400 mg every 6 weeks). Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Physician determined.

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Start blood-pressure control before lenvatinib; treat hypertension promptly.
Manage lenvatinib toxicity (proteinuria, diarrhea, fatigue, hand-foot skin reaction) with interruptions and 4 mg dose-reduction steps.
Have an immune-toxicity (corticosteroid) pathway available for pembrolizumab.
monitoring: Blood pressure frequently early on; urine protein periodically.
Thyroid, liver, and renal function; immune-related adverse-event surveillance.
Response assessment by imaging every 2 to 3 cycles.

drugs.name: Lenvatinib
drugs.notes: Lenvatinib 20 mg by mouth once daily, taken continuously. Oral multi-kinase (VEGFR) inhibitor combined with pembrolizumab for mismatch-repair-proficient advanced/recurrent endometrial carcinoma after progression on platinum. Reduce in 4 mg steps (16 mg, 12 mg, 8 mg) for hypertension, proteinuria, or other toxicity. Flat daily dose; not body-size scaled. Author's own wording; general reference NCCN / DeVita.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV over about 30 minutes on day 1 every 3 weeks (or 400 mg every 6 weeks). Anti-PD-1 partner to lenvatinib. Flat fixed dose; not weight- or BSA-scaled. Author's own wording; general reference NCCN / DeVita.
